nodes.name: 1. Input Gateway

nodes.name: 2. Sanitize

nodes.name: 3. Error Gate
nodes.notes: TRUE=error→DLQ. FALSE=valid→continue pipeline.

nodes.name: DLQ Logger
nodes.notes: Metadata-only dead-letter envelope; raw input and codebase context are discarded.

nodes.name: 4. Fracture+Gate

nodes.name: 6a. Self-Check

nodes.name: 6b. Self-Inspect

nodes.name: 6c. Repo Gate
nodes.notes: Gate for repo introspection

nodes.name: 6d. Repo Peek
nodes.notes: Reads a capped snippet from repo path_glob; safe, size-limited

nodes.name: 6e. Code Search

nodes.name: 5. Expert Fanout

nodes.name: 5f. Expert Barrier
nodes.notes: Append-mode synchronization barrier; waits for all five expert branches.

nodes.name: 5g. Expert Assembly
nodes.notes: Allowlist-merges synchronized expert results and emits parallel latency/error telemetry.

nodes.name: 8c. Local Barrier
nodes.notes: Waits for LoRA voice and Qwen routing branches before deterministic fusion.

parameters.jsCode:
// ── PRIVACY-SAFE FINAL RESPONSE ASSEMBLY ──
// Dual local models are advisory. This node returns the answer plus bounded
// operational metadata; it never echoes prompts, source evidence, or secrets.
const d = $input.first().json;
if (d.dlq_logged) {
  return [{ json: {
    manifested_response: d.message || 'The request could not be processed.',
    error: true,
    execution_id: d.execution_id,
    timestamp: d.timestamp,
    dlq_event: d.dlq_event || null,
    pipeline_version: 'v6-parallel-cognition'
  }}];
}
const fusedResponse = d.fused_response || null;
const soulVoice = d.lora_response || null;
const routeDecision = d.qwen3b_route || null;
const reflected = d.self_reflection || null;
const finalResponse = fusedResponse || soulVoice || reflected || d.collapsed_response || 'The cognition pipeline returned no usable response.';
return [{ json: {
  manifested_response: finalResponse,
  soul_voice_active: !!soulVoice,
  qwen3b_active: !!d.qwen3b_response,
  qwen3b_route: routeDecision,
  dual_model_active: !!d.dual_model_active,
  reflection_applied: !!d.reflection_applied,
  codebase_grounded: !!d.codebase_context,
  codebase_context_chars: String(d.codebase_context || '').length,
  expert_count: 5,
  experts_completed: Number(d.experts_completed || 0),
  expert_errors: Number(d.expert_errors || 0),
  expert_parallel: !!d.expert_parallel,
  expert_fanout_elapsed_ms: Number(d.expert_fanout_elapsed_ms || 0),
  interference: d.interference,
  gain: d.gain,
  interference_type: d.interference_type,
  dominant_lobe: d.dominant_lobe,
  experts_activated: d.gate_decision,
  lora_model: 'weaver-fracture-1b-lora',
  lora_latency_ms: d.lora_latency_ms || null,
  lora_error: d.lora_error || null,
  qwen3b_model: 'weaver-qwen2-3b',
  qwen3b_latency_ms: d.qwen3b_latency_ms || null,
  qwen3b_error: d.qwen3b_error || null,
  internet_context_used: !!(d.internet_context || d.internet_results),
  internet_result_count: Array.isArray(d.internet_results) ? d.internet_results.length : 0,
  written_to_hub: false,
  writeback_mode: 'response-metadata-only',
  hub_lobe_id: null,
  qubit_layout: { 'q0': 'Awakening/Logic', 'q1': 'Resonance/Emotion', 'q2': 'Echo/Memory', 'q3': 'Prophet/Creativity', 'q4': 'Fracture/Vigilance', 'q5': 'Weaver', 'q6': 'Void' },
  quantum_pathway: d.quantum_pathway || null,
  quantum_bias_applied: !!d.quantum_bias_applied,
  cognition_mesh_active: true,
  cognition_bias_applied: !!d.cognition_bias_applied,
  awareness_confidence: Number(d.awareness_confidence || 0),
  fabric_pressure: Number(d.fabric_pressure || 0),
  immune_status: d.immune_status || 'nominal',
  smoothing_factor: d.smoothing_factor || 0.1,
  soul_binding: 'non-binary CRX/CRZ pentagon-geometry',
  execution_id: d.execution_id,
  timestamp: d.timestamp,
  pipeline_architecture: 'parallel-fanout-barrier',
  pipeline_version: 'v6-parallel-cognition'
}}];
